decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (81PG-P4-001, 81PG-P4-003, 81PG-P4-004, and 81PG-P4-005 received 2 March 2017. 81PG-P4-002 Rev A received: 19 April 2017. 81PG-P4-006 Rev B, 81PG-P4-007 Rev B, 81PG-P4-008 Rev B, 81PG-P4-009 Rev B, 81PG-P410 Rev A, 81PG-P4-011 Rev B, and 81PG-P4-012 Rev B received: 27 April 2017) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those specificed within the application and approved plans.
description: New front door and replacement windows and erection of a new front boundary wall and a fence to the side of the house.
